args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding in round_money

The docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212 but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test
test_half_even to fail (e.g. 2.665 must round to 2.66, not 2.67).
Switch the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the failing nightly build where `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expected banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and FIN-212.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (the previously failing test now passes: `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in money.py
